These six public configuration templates are copied unchanged from
jameszeroX/XKeen commit `5aaece27a70d5bd002c615248614914ebbc4569d`, directory
`scripts/_xkeen/02_install/08_install_configs/02_configs_xray`.
They contain upstream examples only, not operator/router configuration.
The empty upstream outbound template is stored as `native-outbounds.json`;
tests map it back to its native filename. This keeps the repository prohibition
on tracked production outbound filenames intact. File contents are unchanged.

Source: https://github.com/jameszeroX/XKeen/tree/5aaece27a70d5bd002c615248614914ebbc4569d/scripts/_xkeen/02_install/08_install_configs/02_configs_xray
